name: strada
description: Strada — a private networking tracker for Berkeley. Neon Postgres + RLS.

scripts.build: npm run build:shared && npm run build --workspace @strada/web && npm run build --workspace @strada/api
scripts.test: npm run build:shared && vitest run --config vitest.config.mts --reporter=verbose
scripts.test:rls: npm run build:shared && node --env-file-if-exists=.env.local ./node_modules/vitest/vitest.mjs run --config vitest.rls.config.mts --reporter=verbose
